mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units, coupled with rising GDP (GDPC1), indicates strong economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite strong growth signals, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low unemployment rates (UNRATE) below 4.5% are associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances despite low unemployment, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeds 2% YoY and simultaneously, the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is above 3% YoY, it signals strong supply-side growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strong supply-side growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in a post-shock recovery regime, a rise in real disposable income (RSAFS) above $750B signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances in post-shock recovery, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI (CPIAUCSL) spread being above 2% indicates a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days due to the attractiveness of equities in a high-real-yield environment.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in high-real-yield environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% within the last 3 months signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to potential inflation concerns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite labor market tightening, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when the growth rate of industrial production (INDPRO) is above 1.5% YoY and simultaneously, the growth rate of payroll employment (PAYEMS) is above 1.2% YoY, it signals balanced growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in balanced growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
